import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

numerical_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr = df[numerical_cols].corr()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1, square=True, 
            cbar_kws={"shrink": .8}, linewidths=0.5, linecolor='gray')
plt.title('Correlation Heatmap of Sleep Health Metrics', fontsize=16)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
